newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian foreign debt rises in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian foreign debt rises in Sept qtr.

text.p: Australia's net foreign debt rose to A$191.194 billion in the September quarter from A$186.866 billion in the June quarter (revised from A$187.804 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compared with net debt of A$180.480 billion a year earlier.
Gross foreign debt rose to A$241.235 billion from A$234.825 billion in the June quarter (revised from A$235.482 billion) compared with A$219.775 billion a year earlier, the bureau said.
Net Foreign Debt Sept Qtr 96 June Qtr 96 Sept Qtr 95
The Bureau said said the ratio of net foreign debt to GDP at the end of the September quarter was 38.8 percent, up from 38.4 percent in the June quarter.
